Layers.NameTooLong.zh: 图层名称不能超过 1024 个字符。

Layers.RenameHint.zh: 再次点击已选中的名称进行重命名
Layers.RenameHint.en: Click the selected name again to rename

Layers.RenameInput.zh: 图层名称；Enter 保存，Esc 取消
Layers.RenameInput.en: Layer name; Enter to save, Esc to cancel

Layers.HelpWithRename.zh:
拖动左侧手柄调整层级；眼睛切换显示，锁切换锁定。再次点击已选中的图层名称，或按 F2 重命名；Enter 保存，Esc 取消，名称留空恢复默认。右键可复制、删除、置顶、置底和编组。

Ctrl+D　复制所选图层
Delete　删除未锁定的所选图层
Ctrl+G　编组
Ctrl+Shift+G　解组
Esc　取消重命名或拖动；否则关闭图层面板
Layers.HelpWithRename.en:
Drag the left handle to reorder; use the eye and lock to change visibility and locking. Click a selected layer name again, or press F2 to rename. Enter saves, Esc cancels, and an empty name restores its default. Right-click for duplicate, delete, ordering and grouping.

Ctrl+D  Duplicate selected layers
Delete  Delete selected unlocked layers
Ctrl+G  Group
Ctrl+Shift+G  Ungroup
Esc  Cancel renaming or dragging; otherwise close the Layers panel
